title: F169.7 the sequence drawn for a phone: the overview
caption: The engine lays a sequence's steps down a phone's width and draws them in the sequence's own look. It says a sequence has a narrow form, so the page shows that drawing on a phone and nothing slides.

cards.title: F169.7 The sequence drawn for a phone
cards.text: On a 390 screen the sequence on How it works reads as steps down the page, at its own size, without sliding.

cards.title: Placed down a width
cards.text: Each call and answer stands under the one before: its two names with a line between, its words under them, wrapped to the room. A block frames its steps. Steps 2 and 3.

cards.title: Drawn in the sequence's look
cards.text: The wide drawing's own beam, dashes, frames and key, and no lifelines. Steps 4 and 5.

cards.title: A sequence has a narrow form
cards.text: The engine says so, and draws the step list for a page that asks for the narrow fit. Step 6.

cards.title: On the page
cards.text: Every picture the nine pages draw has a narrow form, and none slides. A test says so in step 6, and step 7 looks and measures at 390 and 360.

cards.title: The wide drawing stays
cards.text: From 768 pixels the sequence is drawn as it is today, and no picture file in the docs changes.

cards.title: Four kinds still slide
cards.text: A class chart, a nested or a composite picture and a ticket have no narrow form. None of them is on the nine pages.
